the fixture identifiers are synthetic.

Screen states of SCR-21 Asset list and SCR-23 Listing and price: empty is the asset list answer of status 200 with no items; loading is the screen's pending state while a read is in flight; error is the 503 answer of TC-E4-025-04; no access is the 403 answer of TC-E4-025-02. The screens add no field of their own to these states.

the fixture identifiers are synthetic.

Reference data: the lists LOV-SALE-CHANNEL and LOV-LISTING are read by identifier and version under the reference-data contract (DP-06), and the parameters of the floor, the clocks and the codes are read by key under the parameter catalogue (DP-07). The parameter key is Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S5-E4025-CON-20); no value is copied into the baseline.

the fixture identifiers are synthetic.

The round write is API-S5-005 (POST /listings/{listingId}/rounds, TSD S5 T-A.2), declared once for this baseline and the rounds story (RWB-E4-024). The accept rides on that write, and the legacy POST /assets/{assetId}/listings is not its write; the posted fields are agreed at the tag (GAP-2914; ASM-4812).
